membership_rule: The property's OWN postal code, as its own official page states it, joined to the corridor registry. Nothing else admits a property.
coastal_market: Wilmington proper plus the ILM airport corridor and the three beach towns a Wilmington visitor sleeps in. Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach and Kure Beach are separate municipalities and CORE lodging submarkets.

classes.CORE: Downtown Wilmington (28401); Midtown / UNCW (28403); ILM airport / Market Street / Mayfaire (28405); Wrightsville Beach (28480); Carolina Beach / Kure Beach (28428, 28449).
classes.CORRIDOR: Monkey Junction (28409, 28412); Ogden / Porters Neck (28411); Leland / Belville / Navassa (28451).
classes.OUTSIDE: Everything else, refused by name with its postal codes.

evaluated_inclusions.Wrightsville Beach: ADMITTED (CORE) -- oceanfront resort hotels sold as Wilmington beach lodging.
evaluated_inclusions.Carolina Beach: ADMITTED (CORE, Pleasure Island) -- oceanfront and boardwalk hotels.
evaluated_inclusions.Kure Beach: ADMITTED (CORE, Pleasure Island, with Carolina Beach).
evaluated_inclusions.Mayfaire: ADMITTED (CORE, 28405) -- the Military Cutoff hotel cluster at the Wrightsville Beach approach.
evaluated_inclusions.Monkey Junction: ADMITTED (CORRIDOR) -- South College Road hotels on the route to Pleasure Island.
evaluated_inclusions.Leland: ADMITTED (CORRIDOR) -- 4-8 mi over the Cape Fear bridges, Wilmington metro interchange hotels; branding recorded by the census.
evaluated_inclusions.Hampstead: OUTSIDE -- Pender County residential US-17, no Wilmington-branded hotels.
evaluated_inclusions.Topsail Beach / Surf City: OUTSIDE -- Topsail Island is its own beach product.
evaluated_inclusions.Carolina Shores: OUTSIDE -- Grand Strand edge at the SC line.

outside_named_and_refused.why: Pender County US-17 residential community ~20 mi north; no Wilmington-branded hotel inventory; evaluated and refused.

outside_named_and_refused.municipality: Topsail Beach / Surf City / Holly Ridge
outside_named_and_refused.why: Topsail Island -- its own beach product in Pender / Onslow counties, ~30 mi; refused.

outside_named_and_refused.municipality: Southport / Bald Head Island / Boiling Spring Lakes / Caswell Beach
outside_named_and_refused.why: Brunswick Islands destination ~30 mi by road (Bald Head only by ferry); sold as its own vacation market; evaluated and refused.
Brunswick Islands beach town ~35 mi; vacation-rental dominated; evaluated and refused.
Brunswick County on NC-133 / US-17 south of Leland.
Grand Strand edge at the South Carolina line ~50 mi; evaluated and refused.
Pender County seat ~25 mi north on I-40.

observation_is_not_admission: Five cells observe Hampstead, Topsail Island, Southport / Oak Island, Bolivia and Burgaw. They admit nothing.
vacation_rental_rule: The census admits hotel / motel / inn / resort establishments operated as lodging businesses. Individual vacation homes, condos, Airbnb-style units, property-management listings and timeshare units without normal hotel operation are recorded as NON_HOTEL_VACATION_RENTAL exclusions, never admitted.
